snippet.title: Mark Tilbury
snippet.description:
This is my main channel, where I share the lessons I've learned from building a multi-million-dollar business after leaving school at 16 with no qualifications.  Expect practical advice on money, investing, business, and wealth-building.

For all brand partnerships on this channel contact - mark@marktilbury.com
